description: This file contains debugging helper classes and functions for a Flask web application, including custom exceptions, request patching, and template loading diagnostics.

classes.name: UnexpectedUnicodeError
classes.description: Custom error class for better reporting of unicode or binary data issues.

classes.name: DebugFilesKeyError
classes.description: Custom error raised during debugging when a requested file key is missing in request.files.

classes.name: FormDataRoutingRedirect
classes.description: Exception raised in debug mode for improper routing redirects that could cause data loss.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes custom error classes with specific context information.

methods.name: attach_enctype_error_multidict
methods.description: Patches request.files.__getitem__ to provide detailed errors about enctype issues.

methods.name: explain_template_loading_attempts
methods.description: Logs detailed information about attempts to load a template, aiding debugging.
